layers.title: Fiction entity layer
layers.notes: Dedicated fiction-entity layer for novel characters, titles, and in-world named entities, kept separate from everyday/chat phrase seeds and general proper nouns.

sources.name: Cassotis curated fiction entities
sources.notes: Project-maintained fiction entity list for novel characters, titles, and in-world named entities, isolated from the daily/chat preferred-term path and from general proper nouns.

layers.title: Project-maintained proper noun layer
layers.notes: Dedicated general non-person proper-noun layer kept separate from everyday/chat phrase seeds, fiction-specific names, public people names, and domain-specific vertical terminology.

sources.name: Cassotis curated proper nouns
sources.notes: Project-maintained general non-person proper nouns for titles, organizations, brands, platforms, products, and other real-world named entities that should not share the everyday/chat preferred-term path.

layers.title: People name layer
layers.notes: Dedicated public and historical people-name layer kept separate from everyday/chat phrase seeds, fiction-specific names, and non-person proper nouns.

sources.name: Cassotis curated people names
sources.notes: Project-maintained public and historical people names with explicit pinyin corrections, isolated from daily/chat phrase ranking.

sources.name: Wikidata zh historical people
sources.notes: Chinese labels for historical/deceased people with zh-wiki coverage and broad Wikidata sitelink support, imported conservatively as an isolated people-name supplement.

layers.title: Place name layer
layers.notes: Dedicated low-priority place-name layer kept separate from everyday/chat phrase seeds and general proper nouns.

sources.name: Cassotis curated place names
sources.notes: Project-maintained place names with conservative ranking so complete pinyin matches remain inputable without crowding common everyday candidates.

sources.name: Cassotis curated countries and regions
sources.notes: Project-maintained countries, territories, and broad regions with moderately conservative weights.

sources.name: Cassotis curated world cities
sources.notes: Project-maintained high-value world city names kept in the place-name layer.

sources.name: Cassotis curated landmarks
sources.notes: Project-maintained scenic spots and landmarks with conservative weights.

sources.name: Wikidata zh countries
sources.notes: Chinese labels and aliases for countries from Wikidata Query Service.

sources.name: Wikidata zh major cities
sources.notes: Chinese labels for major cities from Wikidata, imported with lower weights than curated city seeds.

sources.name: Wikidata zh administrative territories
sources.notes: Chinese labels for administrative territories with zh-wiki coverage, imported at low weight to avoid crowding everyday candidates.

sources.name: Wikidata zh tourist attractions and landmarks
sources.notes: Chinese labels for tourist attractions and architectural landmarks, imported at low weight so cold buildings and facilities remain available without dominating.

layers.title: Idiom and allusion vertical layer
layers.notes: Dedicated idiom and literary-allusion layer kept separate from everyday/chat phrase seeds and topical named entities.

sources.name: THUOCL chengyu subset
sources.notes: THUOCL chengyu subset used as a conservative idiom/allusion candidate source.

sources.name: Cassotis curated idioms and allusions
sources.notes: Project-maintained high-value idioms and literary allusions kept separate from daily/chat phrase ranking.

layers.title: Computing vertical layer
layers.notes: Dedicated vertical terminology layer kept separate from everyday/chat phrase seeds.

sources.name: THUOCL IT subset
sources.notes: THUOCL IT subset used as a computing/domain terminology candidate layer.

sources.name: Cassotis curated computing terms
sources.notes: Project-maintained computing/domain terminology layer isolated from daily/chat phrase ranking.

layers.title: Civic vertical layer
layers.notes: Dedicated civic, taxation, housing, household-registration, and public-service terminology layer kept separate from everyday/chat phrase seeds.

sources.name: Cassotis curated civic terms
sources.notes: Project-maintained civic/public-service terminology layer for taxation, housing, household-registration, and related administrative vocabulary, isolated from daily/chat preferred-term ranking.

layers.title: Architecture terminology vertical layer
layers.notes: Dedicated architecture terminology layer built from Getty AAT architectural terms, Wikidata architecture terminology, and a small project-maintained supplement.

sources.name: Cassotis curated architecture terms
sources.notes: Project-maintained architecture terminology supplement kept separate from the daily/chat preferred-term path.

sources.name: Getty AAT zh architectural elements
sources.notes: Chinese Getty AAT architectural-element terms queried from the official Getty SPARQL endpoint.

sources.name: Getty AAT zh rooms and spaces
sources.notes: Chinese Getty AAT rooms-and-spaces terms queried from the official Getty SPARQL endpoint.

sources.name: Wikidata zh architectural elements
sources.notes: Chinese labels and aliases for architectural-element subclasses from Wikidata Query Service.

sources.name: Wikidata zh architectural styles
sources.notes: Chinese labels and aliases for architectural styles from Wikidata Query Service.

layers.title: Architecture entity vertical layer
layers.notes: Dedicated architecture-entity layer for landmark buildings and other architecture-specific named entities, kept separate from everyday/chat phrase seeds and general proper nouns.

sources.name: Cassotis curated architecture entities
sources.notes: Project-maintained architecture entity supplement for architects, landmark buildings, and other high-value architecture-specific names.

sources.name: Wikidata zh architectural landmarks
sources.notes: Chinese labels and aliases for architectural landmarks from Wikidata Query Service, imported conservatively as an isolated entity layer.

layers.title: Gaming vertical layer
layers.notes: Dedicated gaming-title and gaming-lexicon layer kept separate from everyday/chat phrase seeds and from general proper nouns.

sources.name: Cassotis curated gaming terms
sources.notes: Project-maintained gaming terminology supplement for high-value game-related wording that should stay isolated from daily/chat preferred-term ranking.

sources.name: Wikidata zh video games
sources.notes: Chinese labels and aliases for video-game items from Wikidata Query Service, used as the main gaming-title/entity source.

sources.name: Wikidata zh video game series
sources.notes: Chinese labels and aliases for video-game series from Wikidata Query Service.

sources.name: Wikidata zh video game genres
sources.notes: Chinese labels and aliases for video-game genres from Wikidata Query Service.

sources.name: Wikidata zh game consoles
sources.notes: Chinese labels and aliases for game consoles from Wikidata Query Service.

sources.name: Wiktionary zh gaming lexical titles
sources.notes: Filtered Chinese Wiktionary titles that match gaming lexical heuristics, used as a lightweight gaming-lexicon supplement.

sources.name: Wikipedia zh gaming lexical titles
sources.notes: Filtered Chinese Wikipedia titles that match gaming lexical heuristics, used as a conservative gaming-lexicon supplement.

layers.title: Game development vertical layer
layers.notes: Dedicated game-development terminology layer built from Godot documentation titles, Wikidata engine terms, and a small project-maintained supplement.

sources.name: Cassotis curated game development terms
sources.notes: Project-maintained game-development terminology supplement kept separate from the daily/chat preferred-term path.

sources.name: Godot Docs zh-cn title index
sources.notes: Filtered Chinese Godot documentation titles used as the main game-development terminology source.

sources.name: Wikidata zh game engines
sources.notes: Chinese labels and aliases for game engines from Wikidata Query Service.

sources.name: Wiktionary zh game-development lexical titles
sources.notes: Filtered Chinese Wiktionary titles that match game-development lexical heuristics.

sources.name: Wikipedia zh game-development lexical titles
sources.notes: Filtered Chinese Wikipedia titles that match game-development lexical heuristics.

layers.title: Medicine vertical layer
layers.notes: Dedicated medical terminology layer built from MeSH-validated Wikidata entities plus a filtered THUOCL medical candidate source.

sources.name: Cassotis curated medical terms
sources.notes: Project-maintained medical supplement for high-value terms and explicit pinyin corrections that should stay isolated from daily/chat preferred-term ranking.

sources.name: MeSH descriptor catalog
sources.notes: Official MeSH descriptor catalog used as the medical concept whitelist for vertical medical import.

sources.name: Wikidata zh medical entities (MeSH-linked)
sources.notes: Chinese medical labels and aliases from Wikidata Query Service, kept only when the linked MeSH descriptor stays inside medical MeSH tree categories.

sources.name: THUOCL medical subset
sources.notes: Medical-domain candidate layer from THUOCL, kept separate from daily/chat phrase ranking and weighted more conservatively than the MeSH-validated medical entities.
